title: Intersectionality in the digital society
place: adesso SE, Dortmund, Germany (online, private event)
description: Intersectionality in the digital society — what does it mean, why is it important, and how do we begin to incorporate it?

title: Intersectionality in the Digital Society
description: Digital accessibility work often focuses on Single-axis Analysis—considering people as “only” disabled while assuming they otherwise lead “normal” lives, with digital competencies, a supportive family, sufficient income, etc. We will explore the concept of intersectionality: what it means, why it matters, and how we can begin incorporating it into our work. 😊
